title: Artem and Array
statementMd:
Artem has an array of $*n*$ positive integers. Artem decided to play with it. The game consists of $*n*$ moves. Each move goes like this. Artem chooses some element of the array and removes it. For that, he gets $*min*(*a*, *b*)$ points, where $*a*$ and $*b*$ are numbers that were adjacent with the removed number. If the number doesn't have an adjacent number to the left or right, Artem doesn't get any points.

After the element is removed, the two parts of the array glue together resulting in the new array that Artem continues playing with. Borya wondered what maximum total number of points Artem can get as he plays this game.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5·10^{5})$ — the number of elements in the array. The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$ — the values of the array elements.

## Output

In a single line print a single integer — the maximum number of points Artem can get.
statementZhMd:
Artem 有一个包含 $*n*$ 个正整数的数组。他决定和这个数组玩一个游戏。游戏由 $*n*$ 次操作组成，每次操作如下：Artem 选择数组中的某个元素并将其删除。为此，他可以获得 $*min*(*a*, *b*)$ 分，其中 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$ 是与被删除数字相邻的两个数。如果该数字左侧或右侧没有相邻数字，Artem 将无法获得任何分数。

删除元素后，数组的两部分会拼接起来，形成一个新数组，Artem 继续在新数组上进行游戏。Borya 想知道，Artem 进行这个游戏时最多可以获得多少总分。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 5·10^{5})$——数组中元素的数量。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$——数组中元素的值。

## 输出格式

在一行中输出一个整数——Artem 可以获得的最大分数。
